from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,re,json

root=Path('D:/repos/.cache/wjr/worktrees/stack-allocator-domain-20261101')
out=Path('D:/repos/.cache/wjr/stack-domain-validation-20261101/codegen')
old=out/'old/wjr/memory'
old.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
(old/'stack_allocator.hpp').write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git','show','e961ba6d:include/wjr/memory/stack_allocator.hpp'],cwd=root))
unit=out/'probe.cpp'
unit.write_text('''#include <wjr/memory/stack_allocator.hpp>
extern "C" __declspec(noinline) void* warm_allocate(wjr::unique_stack_allocator& owner, size_t n) noexcept {return owner.allocate(n);}
extern "C" __declspec(noinline) void scoped_allocate(void(*consume)(void*,size_t), size_t n) {wjr::unique_stack_allocator owner;consume(owner.allocate(n),n);}
''',newline='\n')
for name in ['old','new']:
 include=[str(out/'old')] if name=='old' else []
 include += [str(root/'include'),'D:/repos/wjr/third-party/fmt/include']
 cmd=['python','D:/repos/.cache/wjr/tools/run_with_env.py','D:/LLVM/bin/clang++.exe','-std=c++20','-O2','-DNDEBUG','-DWJR_DEBUG_LEVEL_RELEASE=0']
 cmd+=['-I'+x for x in include]+['-S',str(unit),'-o',str(out/(name+'.s'))]
 subprocess.run(cmd,check=True,capture_output=True)
def instructions(name,symbol):
 s=(out/(name+'.s')).read_text();start=s.index('\n'+symbol+':');end=s.index('\n\t.seh_endproc',start)
 return [line.strip() for line in s[start:end].splitlines() if re.match(r'^\s+[a-z][a-z0-9]*\s',line)]
result={}
for symbol in ['warm_allocate','scoped_allocate']:
 a=instructions('old',symbol);b=instructions('new',symbol)
 result[symbol]=dict(old_instructions=len(a),new_instructions=len(b),identical=a==b)
 if a!=b:
  (out/(symbol+'-diff.txt')).write_text('\n'.join(__import__('difflib').unified_diff(a,b,fromfile='old',tofile='new'))+'\n')
(out/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
